title: Mrs Marion from this out
html_source:
Molly insists that Bloom address her as Mrs Marion as a show of deference.

This is also a reference to how Boylan addressed Molly in his letter to her. A hint that Bloom worries that she has ceased to be his Molly and is now Boylan’s Mrs Marion.
